content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling digital products with crypto payments is more than just a workaround for Stripe's restrictions. It's a fundamental change in how you build and deploy your online store. With infrastructure sovereignty, you own your stack, and no platform can take a cut of your revenue. This means you can sell design assets, like ebooks and templates, directly to customers, without relying on third-party payment gateways. You're in control of your commerce infrastructure, and that's a game-changer.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments is built on a sovereign digital commerce stack. This stack includes a hosting platform, like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic engine, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment processor, like NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment processor verifies the transaction on-chain, and the backend logic engine automates the delivery of the digital product. The entire process happens without relying on Stripe or any other payment gateway.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed for digital creators who want to sell design assets, like ebooks, templates, and fonts, without relying on traditional payment gateways. If you're a creator in a country with restricted access to Stripe or PayPal, this solution is for you. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell your digital products directly to customers, without intermediaries taking a cut of your revenue.
You can sell ebooks, templates, and fonts directly to customers without relying on traditional payment gateways like Stripe and Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include a hosting platform, a backend logic engine, a payment processor, and a file delivery system. The hosting platform, like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, provides a secure and scalable environment for your online store. The backend logic engine, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automates the delivery of digital products and verifies transactions on-chain. The payment processor, like NOWPayments, handles crypto payments and provides real-time transaction verification. Finally, the file delivery system, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensures that digital products are delivered quickly and securely to customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps. First, choose a hosting platform and set up your online store. Next, configure your backend logic engine to automate digital product delivery. Then, integrate a payment processor, like NOWPayments, to handle crypto payments. Finally, deploy your file delivery system to ensure seamless delivery of digital products to customers. With the right tools and knowledge, you can build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full control over your commerce infrastructure.

The most important question a reader would ask is, 'How does this architecture compare to traditional payment gateways like Stripe and Gumroad?' The answer is simple: with a sovereign digital commerce stack, you own your commerce infrastructure, and no platform takes a cut of your revenue. This means you can retain more of your earnings and focus on growing your business without relying on intermediaries.
With infrastructure sovereignty, you own your commerce infrastructure, and no platform takes a cut of your revenue.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps. First, purchase the Complete Builder Kit and download the blueprints and templates. Next, choose a hosting platform and set up your online store. Then, configure your backend logic engine to automate digital product delivery. After that, integrate a payment processor, like NOWPayments, to handle crypto payments. Finally, deploy your file delivery system to ensure seamless delivery of digital products to customers. With these steps, you can build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full control over your commerce infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the cost of using NOWPayments for crypto payments?
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% on every transaction, which is a significant reduction compared to traditional payment gateways like Stripe and Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale.
How does the backend logic engine automate digital product delivery?

The backend logic engine, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automates the delivery of digital products by triggering a pre-configured workflow that sends the product to the customer's email address or downloads folder.
What is the benefit of using a sovereign digital commerce stack?

The benefit of using a sovereign digital commerce stack is that you own your commerce infrastructure, and no platform takes a cut of your revenue. This means you can retain more of your earnings and focus on growing your business without relying on intermediaries.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack to sell physical products?

A sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital products only, but you can use it to sell physical products if you integrate a fulfillment service that automates the shipping and delivery process.
How do I integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments into my sovereign digital commerce stack?

To integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments into your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to configure your backend logic engine to trigger a webhook that sends the transaction data to NOWPayments for verification.
